Subject: A Partnership Opportunity in Healthcare AI
Hi [Clinic Name],

I came across [Clinic Name] and was impressed by how you have scaled while maintaining a strong focus on accessible, patient centred care.

I am building an AI startup focused specifically on private healthcare and I am reaching out because I believe there is a genuine commercial opportunity for us to work together.

We are developing tools that directly address the operational pressures that come with running a growing clinic group, including virtual reception and call handling, appointment scheduling and follow up automation, inbox and document management, and front desk workflow support across locations.

The goal is to reduce the admin burden on your team, improve response times for patients, and free up your staff to focus on higher value work, without the overhead of additional headcount.

We are flexible in how we can help and would be keen to understand any problems or bottlenecks you are experiencing, whether that is around patient enquiries, documentation, scheduling or anything else across your operations. Even if the need is something outside of what I have mentioned, such as your website or other areas of the business, we are happy to explore it. If you are open to it, a short call would be great, though we are equally happy to keep things over email if that is more convenient. You can also check out our website for more details: https://appiah.ai

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,
Himanshu
Founding Engineer - Appiah AI
